# Stomp Shack

> Stomp Shack is a New Orleans queer country line dancing collective. We hold weekly line dancing nights every Sunday at 7pm at Hi-Ho Lounge, 2239 St. Claude Ave, New Orleans, LA. Following the tradition of queer country dance giants Stud Country and Buckwild, Stomp Shack's mission is to spread the pure joy of line dancing all around the Big Easy.

## What

- New Orleans queer country line dancing, every Sunday night @ 7pm at Hi-Ho Lounge, 2239 St. Claude Ave, New Orleans, LA 70116
- Traditional line dances as well as new dances hitting the scene, across musical genres - not only country
- No experience necessary and no partner needed - we teach at least two dances each night
- Wear whatever you're comfortable in; leather-soled cowboy boots are helpful but not required
- An explicitly queer, but not exclusively queer space - allies who respect the community are more than welcome
- Led by Haley Rowe-Kadow, a New Orleans local
